title: Edgar Mitchell's ESP experiment in space
summary: RedPandaKoala tells of Edgar Mitchell's ESP experiment in space, about 1971 at Apollo 14, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh but he tried to do it while he was in orbit. It was the first ever like psychic experiment in space.

plain: The astronaut Edgar Mitchell, while flying on Apollo 14, the 1971 NASA mission to the Moon, is said to have run a private test of mind reading from orbit, what the researcher who goes by RedPandaKoala calls "the first ever like psychic experiment in space." RedPandaKoala tells it without naming a source, and links it to J.B. Rhine, a scientist known for studying extrasensory perception, the idea that minds can sense things without the usual senses. The point of telling it is that even a NASA astronaut took that kind of question seriously enough to test it in space.
